title: Rules
description: Set these with a clear head. Every pre-trade check measures an order against them.
limits.title: Account limits
limits.description: Percentages are of the account value.
limits.totalOpenRisk.hint: The most you can lose if every stop triggers together.
limits.dailyLoss.hint: New orders are blocked for the rest of the day once reached.
limits.cautionAt: Caution starts at, % of a limit
classes.title: Coin class rules
classes.description: Stop distance is the multiplier times the coin's daily movement. A wider stop means a smaller position, so the money at risk stays the same.
classes.scrollLabel: Coin class rules, scroll horizontally to see all columns
discipline.title: Discipline rules
discipline.description: Promises you make to yourself. Metron either blocks the order or warns and records it.
discipline.cooldown.name: Cooldown after a loss
discipline.cooldown.detail: No new order for {n0} minutes after a position closes at a loss.
discipline.hours.name: No orders after {n0}
discipline.hours.detail: No new order between {n0} and {n1} UTC.
discipline.stop.name: A stop is never widened
discipline.stop.detail: A stop can move toward the price, never away from it.
discipline.footer: A rule cannot be loosened while it is counting down or within an hour of a loss.
